name: JoAi: Open Integration Settings

description.en: Show a chat card to configure an integration such as calendar or Cloudflare in a dialog.
description.de: Zeigt eine Chat-Karte, um eine Integration wie Kalender oder Cloudflare im Dialog einzurichten.
description.es: Muestra una tarjeta en el chat para configurar una integración como calendario o Cloudflare en un diálogo.
description.fr: Affiche une carte dans le chat pour configurer une intégration comme calendrier ou Cloudflare dans une boîte de dialogue.
description.ro: Afișează un card în chat pentru a configura o integrare precum calendar sau Cloudflare într-un dialog.
description.it: Mostra una card in chat per configurare un'integrazione come calendario o Cloudflare in una finestra di dialogo.

bot: Use when the user needs to connect an integration. Delivers a chat embed with a Configure button that opens the setup dialog (does not navigate away). Pass integration slug (e.g. cloudflare, google-search-console, calendar). Optionally pass agentId to preselect that agent in the dialog.

inputs.name: Integration

description.en: Integration slug such as calendar, cloudflare, or google-search-console
description.de: Integrations-Slug wie calendar, cloudflare oder google-search-console
description.es: Slug de integración como calendar, cloudflare o google-search-console
description.fr: Slug d'intégration comme calendar, cloudflare ou google-search-console
description.ro: Slug-ul integrării, de ex. calendar, cloudflare sau google-search-console
description.it: Slug integrazione come calendar, cloudflare o google-search-console

inputs.bot: Integration slug to configure. Use calendar for appointment setup, cloudflare or google-search-console for site metrics.

inputs.name: Agent

description.en: Optional agent UUID to preselect in the setup dialog
description.de: Optionale Agent-UUID zur Vorauswahl im Setup-Dialog
description.es: UUID opcional del agente a preseleccionar en el diálogo
description.fr: UUID d'agent optionnel à présélectionner dans la boîte de dialogue
description.ro: UUID opțional al agentului de preselectat în dialog
description.it: UUID agente opzionale da preselezionare nel dialogo

inputs.bot: Optional agent UUID. Prefer the agent that should own the integration (e.g. Maya).

success.en: Set up {{integration}} to continue. Use Configure below.
success.de: Richte {{integration}} ein, um fortzufahren. Nutze unten Einrichten.
success.es: Configura {{integration}} para continuar. Usa Configurar abajo.
success.fr: Configure {{integration}} pour continuer. Utilise Configurer ci-dessous.
success.ro: Configurează {{integration}} pentru a continua. Folosește Configurează mai jos.
success.it: Configura {{integration}} per continuare. Usa Configura qui sotto.
